Private; no equity round, Form D or financing release found (EDGAR full-text probes for "Kairos Power" return no Form D; kairospower.com newsroom has no round announcements; see docs/survey/probes/newsrooms.md). Lifetime equity raised is therefore NOT evidenced and left out. The only investor-side event is the Samsung C&T binding term sheet (2026-09-21, up to $100M, part in-kind engineering services). DISCREPANCY KEPT OPEN (do not merge): DOE announcements state a DOE share of up to $303M (total award value $629M over seven years) for the ARDP Risk Reduction / Hermes award, while USAspending award DENE0009325 (recipient KAIROS POWER LLC, type 11 technology investment agreement, signed 2024-02-12) shows a total obligation of $135.0M, $126.858M account outlays and $0 non-federal funding. The two are recorded as separate events (ardp-doe-announced-2020, ardp-doe-tia-2024, ardp-usaspending-obligated) sharing round_group ardp-risk-reduction-hermes so a reconciler can see they concern the same programme; they must not be summed. VERIFIER (2026-10-05): only the USAspending obligation ($135M, of which $126.858M outlaid) counts as new_money; the 2024 TIA "up to $303M" is the milestone ceiling (amount_kind ceiling) and the 2020 selection announcement of the same $303M DOE share is a duplicate of the TIA. Plausible explanation (NOT evidenced): USAspending obligates milestone tranches incrementally, so obligated < ceiling. USAspending recipient total for DOE FY20-26 is $135.5M (snapshot 243d1e1f). Small items not made into events: GAIN voucher (2019, no amount), NSUF/TCF awards 2019 (project value ~$50M is a facility project, not Kairos money), SBA loan 4181827109 $3.3M 2020 (apparently pandemic loan, not evidenced here), University of Wisconsin pass-through DEAR0001293 $0.8M. Hermes 1 HALEU supply contract with DOE (2026-01-20) has no stated value. Kairos stated in 2021 it would itself invest $100M in the Oak Ridge demonstration (state release) - not a funding event. Westinghouse+Kairos "$18mn of SMR funding" (2019-04-03) page has no body text in the snapshot, so not used. NOTE doe-industry-opportunities-2020: announced_on is the USAspending award start date, not a press date. NOTE samsung-ct-strategic-investment-2026: up to $100M is 'a combination of direct investment and in-kind engineering services, subject to regulatory approvals'; cash/in-kind split undisclosed so amount may overstate new cash; term sheet, not a closed round.
